method: Recursive byte-string search followed by ELF metadata inspection

candidates.evidence: Contains strings naming all six mapped feature libraries at file offsets 0x373c, 0x376f, 0x3a09, 0x3b23, 0x3d0a, and 0x3d44; exports IMDB_find_entry, IMDB_get_entries, and IMDB_find_target_bit.

candidates.limitation: The registry's caller and relationship to dynamic loading remain unproven.

candidates.limitation: The executable's DT_NEEDED list does not include libInfraWebApi.so, and no dynamic-loader call has yet been tied to this string.
